Meaning: Equated Monthly Instalment - the fixed amount paid every month to repay a loan

Example: Borrowing Rs 5 lakh means principal = Rs 5 lakh

Meaning: The time period over which the loan is repaid
The cost of borrowing, charged as a % per year
A 3-digit number (300-900) showing how reliably a person repays loans
Detailed record of a person's loans, cards and repayments
No credit history - the person has never taken a loan or credit card
Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio = (all monthly EMIs incl. new one / monthly income) x 100
Loan-to-Value ratio = loan amount / value of the asset x 100
Example: Rs 40 lakh loan on Rs 50 lakh flat = 80%

Meaning: An asset given as security; bank can take it if loan is not repaid
A second person who shares responsibility for repaying the loan
Asset stays with borrower but bank has a claim on it until loan is repaid
A period during which EMIs do not have to be paid
Example: Course period of an education loan

Meaning: Non-Performing Asset - a loan on which payments are overdue for more than 90 days
Know Your Customer - verifying identity and address of a customer
